name: AI Chat
author: WolfyMaster LLC
description: Gives chat an AI helper that answers !ask questions and @mentions, and can write lines for you. Uses your own AI account.

settings.label: AI service
settings.description: Type anthropic for Claude or openai for ChatGPT.

settings.label: AI key
settings.description: The key from the AI service you picked.

settings.label: Model
settings.description: Leave blank to use the recommended model.

settings.label: Personality
settings.description: Tell the AI who to be, like a pirate, a hype squad, or a calm helper.
settings.defaultValue: You are a friendly, upbeat helper in a live stream's chat. Keep it kind, fun and family friendly.

settings.label: Longest reply (characters)
settings.description: Longer replies are cut short. Twitch allows up to 500.

settings.label: Wait between questions (seconds)
settings.description: How long each viewer waits before asking again. 0 turns it off.

settings.label: Answer @mentions
settings.description: Answers chat messages that @mention the bot name below.

settings.label: Bot name
settings.description: The name viewers @mention to talk to the AI, without the @.

actions.name: Ask AI
actions.description: Ask the AI to write something, like a welcome for a raider. Later steps can use its reply. The step fails if the AI can't be reached or the key is wrong.

schema.label: What to ask
schema.placeholder: Write a one-line hype welcome for a raider named ${trigger.data.fromBroadcasterUserName}
schema.description: What the AI should write or answer.

fields.description: The AI's reply, on one line.

actions.name: Answer chat question with AI
actions.description: Answers the question after a chat command, tagging the viewer. Viewers wait between questions.

fields.description: True when an answer was posted in chat.
The answer posted in chat. Blank if nothing was posted.

actions.name: Answer chat mention with AI
actions.description: Answers a chat message that @mentions the bot, when Answer @mentions is on.

fields.description: True when an answer was posted in chat.
The answer posted in chat. Blank if nothing was posted.
